verdict.rationale: The CLI installs one skill collection into several agents in a single command (`-a claude-code -a opencode`). It names Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and about 75 more supported agents, writes to per-agent `./<agent>/skills/` or `~/<agent>/skills/` directories, and symlinks each agent to one canonical copy. A community comment praises the agent-agnostic approach. Missing for 10: explicit per-harness setup instructions or per-agent behavior documentation in the evidence, and hands-on corroboration of installing one collection across several harnesses.
